angleEvidenceBrief: The angle is that the published count of human rabies deaths is a count of reporting. The evidence is WHO's own Global Health Observatory indicator NTD_RAB2 frozen as downloaded, one year of it, joined to Natural Earth 1:50m on ADM0_A3 with every silence declared: 1 alias (SSD to SDS, a country that reported 249), 94 countries whose own cell reads No data, and 1 reading that lands on no shape at all (French Guiana, 3). Of the 195 countries in WHO's 2024 row, 57 reported at least one death, 44 reported zero and 94 filed nothing; the 101 that filed reported 3021 between them, 3018 of which this map can put on a shape. WHO's own fact sheet puts the annual toll at about 59000. Nothing on the page is divided by anything: the file carries no population, and the beat's brief records reading raw with the reason.
